$comment: Server functions that rebuild a Space's document catalog, or list or stat every document or thread file. This list can only shrink: read through the catalog snapshot, thread digests or other derived data instead of adding to it. A site is <file>#<function>[.<variable>]; kind is the builder it calls. Checked by bun run perf:guards; see docs/performance.md.
